entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you...
Yeah, hi. I need to return a jersey. Can I get an order number to you?
Of course. I can help with that. Can you please provide the order number?
Got it. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the Aero Race Jersey. Just to be sure I'm logging this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a big ride and it's just way too tight. I need to do an exchange for a larger size.

I understand. I'm just checking our return policy against your delivery date. Okay, looks like you received this 77 days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process this for you.
Great. So you'll send me the exchange?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return authorization for the original jersey. I'm sending an email to you now with the prepaid shipping label. Just send that back to us, and once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. You can then place a new order for the correct size whenever you're ready.
A refund is fine. As long as I can get my money back. I'll watch for the email. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
